name: Descriptionandsituation Pattern
description: The Description and Situation content ontology design pattern. This CP represents conceptualizations i.e., descriptions, and corresponding groundings i.e., situations. The pattern is extracted from DOLCE+DnS Ultralite by partial cloning of elements, and is composed of three other CPs: description, situation, and classification.
competency_questions: Which actual state of affairs satisfies a given plan or set of rules, and which plan does an observed state of affairs satisfy?; What different descriptions has the same thing been given — the same building treated as a home, as an investment and as a heritage site — and which things does a particular description apply to?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
